notes_for_editor: Name-only match. OSM node 358997103 and TopoZone both place a Murrell Hill Lookout Tower in Russell County at 32.2132066, -85.0788214, roughly 20 km from the register point for us-al-murrell-hill (32.3454, -85.245). Not merged, and not cited as the same structure; a human should decide. The only status signal is the OSM fixme 'Is this still there?'. The OSM node's history shows only a gnis-tag cleanup, which is not a status change. Not checked: Alabama Forestry Commission records, and the ExpertGPS Alabama towers list, which carries the same name at the OSM point but was not read.
